P1.1.text: Global Partner For Irrigation & Infrastructure - Lindsay

P1.2.text: We expand the world's potential with advanced irrigation, infrastructure & industrial technology to benefit us all.

P1.5.text: Innovation that meets the world’s growing food, fuel, fiber and transportation needs with sustainable technology.

P1.6.text: Innovating and expanding our world's potential.

P1.7.text: Providing advanced irrigation, infrastructure, and industrial technology solutions that benefit us all.

P1.8.text: We know every drop—and every minute—matters. That’s why our irrigation solutions are built for growers who demand reliable performance. From durable Zimmatic pivots to smart, easy-to-use FieldNET water management technology, we help you increase yields, save time, and get more from every acre. With responsive support from trusted local dealers and a full lineup of innovative products, Lindsay is here to help you grow stronger—season after season.

P1.9.text: We’re shaping the future of transportation with innovative safety solutions and integrated systems that protect drivers, road workers, and entire communities. From advanced crash cushions and barrier systems to intelligent traffic management and remote asset monitoring, our infrastructure solutions are engineered to meet the evolving needs of today’s roadways. Whether you’re planning a major highway project, managing a busy work zone, or installing lifesaving hardware, we’re committed to helping you keep traffic moving—safely, efficiently, and sustainably.

P1.10.text: See how our products are transforming farms and roadways across the globe.

P1.11.text: At Lindsay, real-world results speak volumes. Lindsay’s case studies highlight real success across both irrigation and infrastructure. From boosting crop yields with precision technology to improving road safety and traffic flow, these stories show how our solutions deliver measurable results. Each case reflects our commitment to innovation, performance, and helping customers build more efficient, sustainable operations.

P2.1.text: About Lindsay Corporation | Our Company Vision & Values

P2.2.text: Learn how Lindsay advances irrigation, infrastructure and tech through innovation, values and a commitment to progress.

P2.3.text: Lindsay prides itself on innovating state-of-the-art technology, manufacturing dependable products, and cultivating genuine partnerships with our customers and each other. Our purpose is simple—to conserve natural resources, expand our world’s potential, and enhance the quality of life for people. we’ve led in the development of innovative products that save time and deliver peace of mind—because real progress isn’t just about technology; it’s about making a tangible difference in people’s lives.

P2.4.text: Boldly powering change. Bravely creating opportunity.

P2.5.text: Our vision is to be the innovation and market leader in our core segments, including irrigation and infrastructure equipment and technology. We are at the forefront of research and development of sustainable solutions to meet the food, fuel, fiber, and transportation needs of the world’s rapidly growing population.

P2.6.text: A global leader with small town values.

P2.7.text: At Lindsay, we are committed to building relationships with customers and each other. Our global footprint is driven by our commitment to fostering personal connections and maintaining reliability and trustworthiness.

P2.8.text: Through trusted long-lasting relationships, innovative, dependable products, and truly caring support, we help make our customers’ work and lives easier, safer, and more fulfilling so the world can keep progressing. Together.

P2.9.text: The people who make progress possible.

P2.10.text: Lindsay is driven by a team of more than 1,300 hardworking individuals across the globe who are united by pride and passion for our work. We want to ensure every person returns home safely every night.

P1.2.text: Trinity Industries, Inc. owns market-leading businesses that provide railcar products and services in North America under the trade name TrinityRail®. TrinityRail’s unique platform provides a single source for comprehensive rail transportation solutions that optimizes our customers’ ownership and usage of railcar equipment and enhances the value-proposition of the rail modal supply chain.

P1.3.text: Our purpose is to Deliver Goods for the Good of All.

P1.4.text: Delivering Goods for the Good of All™

P1.5.text: It’s more than a motto — it’s our purpose. Rail transports the goods that keep our lives, our communities, and our economy thriving, and TrinityRail is proud to keep North America’s rail shippers moving forward.

P1.6.text: TrinityRail is an industry-leading railcar leasing company, enhanced by our manufacturing and service capabilities. We are a leader in providing leasing and logistics services, and act as an integrated and strategic partner to stakeholders across the industry. We are on a mission to increase rail’s modal share and convenience by delivering more sustainable, end-to-end solutions that bridge the first and last miles for our customers.

P1.7.text: years in business 50+ years manufacturing railcars, 40+ years leasing railcars

P1.8.text: major commercial end markets serving 21 different commodity markets with the broadest railcar product offering in North America

P1.10.text: Trinity Industries celebrating 50 years of being on the NYSE on

P1.11.text: As a leading railcar lessor enabled by rail transportation manufacturing and services in North America, Trinity Industries is committed to supporting a more sustainable future and making meaningful contributions to address our long-term impact.

P1.12.text: We are dedicated to integrating sustainability principles, including socially responsible and environmentally conscious corporate practices, grounded in a robust governance framework to ensure we continue operating at the industry's highest standards.

P2.1.text: Trinity Industries, Inc. - About - About Us

P2.2.text: Trinity began providing industrial products and services to customers more than 85 years ago. We started as a small butane-tank manufacturer and evolved over time into a premier provider of railcar products and services in North America with a leading railcar lease fleet and manufacturing, maintenance and repair operations.

P2.3.text: Our rail-related products and services are marketed under the trade name TrinityRail. Our purpose is to Deliver Goods for the Good of All.

P2.4.text: The TrinityRail platform plays an important role in the North American supply chain by facilitating the transportation of bulk commodities and goods by rail. Railcar transportation is sustainable and is the most economical land-based mode of transportation. At Trinity, we strive to employ company resources in ways that make positive contributions to our stakeholders for the benefit of current and future generations.

P2.5.text: TrinityRail’s platform aims to deliver innovative solutions that optimize the life-cycle ownership and usage of railcar equipment and enhance the value-proposition of the rail modal supply chain. We differentiate our value proposition to all stakeholders by:

P2.6.text: leveraging our rail expertise across a broad market viewpoint,

P2.7.text: working collaboratively to provide an unparalleled customer experience, and

P2.8.text: delivering significant financial and commercial synergies that create a strategic advantage.

P2.9.text: Our market leadership, performance and growth through the years are attributable to:

P2.11.text: the quality of our rail products and services,

P2.12.text: the depth of our operational capabilities, market insight and expertise, and

P2.13.text: our cultural commitment to excellence and continuous improvement.

P3.1.text: Trinity Industries, Inc. - About - Trinity Platform

P3.2.text: The TrinityRail Platform and Operating Model

P3.3.text: At Trinity, we are committed to Delivering Goods for the Good of All. Look around and you’ll see us. Our railcars have likely carried the materials that built them. We may have delivered it from the farm to grocer. We likely transported and fueled it. That’s us too.
